reviews.t: It never opened after I set the combination
reviews.x: We needed a little locking bag for medicine in our upstairs bathroom because we are licensed foster parents. I followed the directions to set the new combination for this little bag and it never opened. We tried every single combination remotely next to the combination I set it to, but alas, it is just a bag that does not open.  Huge waste of money and time.  I should have spent time reading reviews before I ordered it.

reviews.t: Great for meds (including refridgerated ones) w/ lots of storage space and pockets.
reviews.x: I use this product for medications and its awesome. I love the interior pockets and the two removable (snap in) zip punches. I can hold 4-6 medication bottles in one zip pouch and then i even keep expensive make up and other things in it too because the walls of the bag are lined with pockets and holders. Its so great. The combo was easy to set up and so far its worked seemlessly every time.  It first in my purse too for when i go pick up my medications.  Its even big enough to fit a journal/dia

reviews.t: Faulty lock.. waste of money
reviews.x: Beautiful & I love the concept of being able to lock it. However, the lock mechanism was faulty. I don’t know if I was just unlucky with this purchase & got a messed up one. I couldn’t spin one dial without the one next to it spinning as well. So, when I was trying to set up the code, it wouldn’t open anymore at all & there’s no way to reset it. So, I had to cut the bag open. Of course I couldn’t return or exchange it... such a waste of money.

reviews.t: I had the case less than a month before the ...
reviews.x: I had the case less than a month before the zipper attached to the lock broke. I really needed to secure medications, so I can no longer use the bag. It did not receive heavy use. I unlocked and locked it once a day, and it was not handled roughly. I opened the lock, and I heard a piece of metal hit the floor, and the zipper pull and half the piece holding on were gone.

reviews.t: Don't buy it for the lock
reviews.x: It really depends on why you are buying this item on whether or not you will like it.  If you are looking for a very sturdy case with a secure lock, then this is NOT for you.  If you want something this size, in a cute color that is portable and water-resistant with a little bit of an extra deterrent to open it, then you will probably like this product.  I really wanted the lock to be better, but sadly it really is not.  It does work, but it is awkward and flimsy and would be VERY easy to break

reviews.t: nice little travel bag (But needs some kind of protective cover prior ,to avoid premature  wear )
reviews.x: Good for travel. Seems to do the job and keeps  every thing secure.  Easy to set lock. Opening and closing can be a bit awkward  at first but after a few tries you will get the hang of how it works. The inside organization and design is useful. But when I got it in the mail it had no protective plastic covering. So , it arrived with some long scratches to the fabric and  tumbler lock hardware making it look used in appearance.  I did not bother to return it, as it will just get more with travel

claims.text: Many reviewers love the case for securely storing small valuables like medications, supplements, makeup, and feminine products, praising its quality and design.
Several reviewers report lock problems, including codes that won't open, dials that spin together, and locks that fail to lock or unlock reliably.
Some reviewers note the lock can be tricky to operate but is fine once you turn the key or dial far enough, and one had a zipper attached to the lock break.
Reviewers appreciate the interior organization, including removable snap-in pouches, brush holders, adjustable dividers, and multiple pockets.
A few reviewers wish the case had more pockets or compartments.

qa.q: Will my makeup fit in this case?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate makeup fits well: one reviewer says it "fits everything i use regularly well" [1], and another says it holds their cosmetics with adjustable dividers [2]. However, one reviewer notes eyeshadow palettes may require removing dividers [1], and another mentions the upper tray is awkward to access [6].

claims.text: It fits everything the reviewer uses regularly well.
It holds cosmetics and has adjustable dividers.
You may need to take out dividers to fit eyeshadow palettes.
The upper tray is awkward to access.

qa.q: Is the lock durable and secure?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability and security: some call the lock cheap and flimsy [1] or say it broke within a month [6], while others describe it as secure and well designed [2][4][5]. One reviewer explicitly says not to buy it for the lock if you want a secure lock [3].

claims.text: One reviewer calls the lock extremely cheap and flimsy [1].
One reviewer reports the zipper attached to the lock broke in under a month [6].
Other reviewers describe the lock as secure and well designed [2][4][5].
One reviewer says not to buy it for the lock if you want a secure lock [3].
